criteria.title: Item correspondence and silhouette
criteria.check: Compare item/model code, completeness of pair or set, outline, and visible proportions.
criteria.criticalFail: Wrong item or changed product outline.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Stone layout and appearance
criteria.check: Compare visible count, arrangement, spacing, and color appearance with available evidence.
criteria.criticalFail: Added or removed stones or altered layout.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Settings and connections
criteria.check: Trace prongs, bezels, galleries, chain links, clasps, and attachments.
criteria.criticalFail: Invented, missing, or broken visible construction.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Marks, engraving, and condition
criteria.check: Compare readable marks and relevant wear or distinctive item features.
criteria.criticalFail: Changed text or hidden selling-relevant condition.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Material and tone
criteria.check: Use a trusted appearance reference and consistent viewing conditions.
criteria.criticalFail: Material substitution or unsupported material implication.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Boundaries, reflections, and transparency
criteria.check: Review edges, openings, facets, shadows, and reflection transitions.
cosmeticExamples: Minor background artifact without product change
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Worn contact and scale
criteria.check: Compare attachment, placement, and apparent proportions to the already-worn source.
criteria.criticalFail: Implausible attachment or materially changed proportions.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Destination and collection presentation
criteria.check: Review crop, framing, readability, background, and collection consistency.
cosmeticExamples: Inconsistent framing without hidden required detail
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

criteria.title: Temporal identity and implied behavior
criteria.check: Review the entire video, transitions, and new views; compare with sources.
criteria.criticalFail: Changing construction or unsupported product mechanism.
criteria.rule: Severity is assigned to the observed discrepancy for its declared use; critical failures block acceptance.

decisionRules.criticalFail: Reject this output version for intended use.
decisionRules.requiredUnverified: Block approval until evidence resolves the required criterion.
decisionRules.cosmeticFail: Route to a defined correction or manual finishing; reinspect final output.
decisionRules.notApplicable: Record applicability=false with a reason; do not fabricate a pass.
decisionRules.approval: All required applicable criteria supported, no unresolved critical failures, and named destination approved.
decisionRules.collection: Risk-based sample tests the process; each released item/output still needs approval.
decisionRules.video: Approve source then review full clip; timestamp checks alone do not prove all frames correct.
